name: Strava
title: strava.com
shortDescription: Strava is a fitness tracking app that caters to athletes and outdoor enthusiasts. It allows users to record and share their activities such as running, cycling, and hiking with a community of over 100 million people. Users can track their performance, compare with past activities, and explore new routes. Strava also offers features like real-time location sharing for safety.
